notes:
- New short-form format: Type Stack. Your B-roll cutaways carry stacked type (a small lead line, one big word, an italic line under it), each word landing as it is said, plus a few stacked lines on the speaker. Plain captions in between, held until the next words.
- The stacks are chosen the way the approved lab edit chose them; the italic line is Playfair Display. The camera pushes in slowly on every shot, one way only, and the clip is made at 60 frames a second. Needs a B-roll folder in Creators, Editing.
